name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab

breadcrumb.name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab

tagline: SPACER TAB FOR EXPOSED PAVER RETAINER SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab is an attachment used on top of adjustable pedestals to secure pavers down and increase wind uplift resistance. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® Exposed Paver Retainer to form a complete wind uplift system. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Exposed Paver Retainer Spacer Tab may be manufactured with tabs of various thicknesses to create varying drainage gaps sizes, to support concrete pavers, stone pavers, and porcelain tiles that have a minimum thickness of 20 mm.
